column7: What's the best investment you've ever made in your life? It doesn't have to be financial — it could be an investment in your education, health, relationships, experiences, or even yourself. Why was it worth it?
column8: What is one gadget, app, or piece of technology that you find useful or that makes your life much easier? How do you use it?
column9: What is one unwritten rule you wish someone had told you before you learned it the hard way? It could be an unwritten rule in your family, daily life, or workplace etc.
column10: Is your current job the same as what you dreamed of when you were 8? If not, what is the ONE thing you’d love to say through this hotline to your 8-year-old self?
